name: Azure Glow
description: Lift a blue-white glow over the user and read the faces that move in it.

name: Tidal Shove
description: Shove a foe back with a tide of lunar force from the shoulder.

name: Waning Guard
description: Let a guard wane as a blow nears so little force is left to land.

name: Mooncall Pull
description: Call the tide of the moon to settle on a foe's stance.

name: Wane Touch
description: Touch a technique at its peak and make it wane at once.

name: Waxing Gift
description: Wax an ally's strength to its fullest for a short hour.

name: Grand Tide
description: Raise a grand tide of pull and push that rolls over a whole front.

name: Mastered Phase
description: Step one phase aside from a heavy blow and turn its force against the striker.

name: Azure Eclipse
description: Darken the whole field in a gentle eclipse that blinds and weighs down every foe in it.

name: Twin Glow
description: Cast two glows from the two hands and read what each one touches.

name: Paired Tug
description: Tug a foe's two arms apart with two unseen pulls.

name: Duet Shove
description: Shove with both palms in turn so the second push lands on the first.

name: Matched Halo
description: Ring the user with two halos that each dim a blow in turn.

name: Two-Tide Pull
description: Run two tides against each other round a foe so its footing never settles.

name: Mirrored Wake
description: Wake two allies at once so each strengthens as the other stirs.

name: Counter Phase
description: Meet a blow with its opposite phase and return its force to the striker.

name: Dual Eclipse
description: Cross two phases over a strong foe until it loses both sight and weight.

name: Dual Surge
description: Send a surge from each hand that meet in the middle of a group of foes.

name: Twin Moon
description: Hold a mighty foe between two pulls that give it no way forward or back.

name: Hawk Gleam
description: Sharpen the pale glow to a hawk's gaze that picks one foe from many.

name: Moon Talon
description: Strike with fingers curved and edged in light like a talon.

name: Perch Glow
description: Hold a high glow overhead that thins blows falling from above.

name: Stooping Pull
description: Drop a sudden pull on a foe from above that spoils its footing.

name: Skyward Tide
description: Draw a tide upward through a foe so its limbs rise and cannot strike.

name: Keen Reflection
description: Catch the faint reflection of a hidden foe in any bright surface.

name: Talon Eclipse
description: Eclipse a foe's sight for a breath and strike in the dark that follows.

name: Soaring Tide
description: Lift a tide from the ground and let it fall back across the foes below.

name: Lunar Seizure
description: Seize a lone champion from a height with a pull that nothing near can break.

name: Master Glow
description: Raise a clear glow that shows every small thing near the user.

name: Mortal Pull
description: Pull a foe's heavy blow off line with the full strength of a mortal master.

name: Strong Phase
description: Hold the guard at its fullest phase so it turns even a heavy blow.

name: Waxing Strength
description: Wax the strength of an ally who stands near by a steady measure.

name: Anchor Tide
description: Anchor a tide of pull on one foe and hold it as long as the user stands firm.

name: Mastered Mirror
description: Hold a mirror of perfect polish that returns a heavy blow in kind.

name: Mortal Eclipse
description: Cross the master's glow over a foe to dim its sight and weigh its limbs.

name: Master Tide
description: Raise the master's tide across a short front with a force beyond ordinary mortal power.

name: Mortal Moon
description: Bring the full moon down on a strong foe and hold it motionless under the weight.

name: Sworn Glow
description: Raise a glow sworn to show only what is true.

name: Sworn Tug
description: Tug a foe's weapon sideways with a pull sworn to hold its line.

name: Wind Shove
description: Shove a foe back on a gust of lunar force.

name: Steady Halo
description: Hold a halo steady round the user against a buffeting wind of blows.

name: Oath Pull
description: Draw a foe toward a promise it has made by a pull that grows when it resists.

name: Bearing Wake
description: Wake the steadiness in an ally and fix it to a chosen bearing.

name: Gust Phase
description: Move one phase aside on a gust so a blow strikes empty air.

name: Wind-Sworn Eclipse
description: Draw a sworn eclipse across a strong foe's sight and strength together.

name: Unwalled Surge
description: Send a wide surge of tide with no wall for shelter at any point of the front.

name: Sworn Moon
description: Swear a full moon over a powerful foe and hold the foe motionless to its weight.

name: Vow Glow
description: Raise a glow that grows brighter near a kept vow and dimmer near a broken one.

name: Vowed Tug
description: Tug a foe's sword hand with a pull that obeys the user's word.

name: Oath Halo
description: Wear a halo that holds firm while the user keeps faith.

name: Promise Tide
description: Raise a tide on a promise-breaker that weighs more with each lie.

name: Vow Wake
description: Wake the strength an ally has pledged to give to a cause.

name: Kept Phase
description: Return a blow by the light of a kept vow to the one who broke faith.

name: Oath Eclipse
description: Eclipse the sight of a foe who has sworn falsely and weigh its limbs.

name: Vow Surge
description: Send a surge of tide that strikes hardest at foes who have broken a vow.

name: Oathbound Moon
description: Bind a mighty foe under a moon that weighs by the oaths it has sworn.

name: Heading Glow
description: Raise a glow in the chosen direction and read how far each thing lies from it.

name: Bearing Tug
description: Tug a foe's bearing off true so the foe veers.

name: Bearing Halo
description: Hold a halo fixed to a bearing so blows from a side slide past.

name: Bearing Tide
description: Run a tide along the held bearing so every foe on it slows.

name: Held Wake
description: Wake in allies the habit of keeping to the bearing under pressure.

name: Bearing Reflection
description: Reflect a blow along the bearing back to the one who sent it.

name: Bearing Eclipse
description: Cross an eclipse over foes who stray from the bearing and slow them.

name: Tidal Reach
description: Reach out along the bearing with a tide that shoves all it crosses.

name: Bearing Moon
description: Hold a mighty foe on the bearing under a moon it cannot pull away from.

name: Master Gleam
description: Throw a keen gleam that shows the weak seam in a foe's guard.

name: Master Tug
description: Tug a heavy blow off line with the strength of a mortal master.

name: Sworn Shove
description: Shove a foe back with a push sworn to carry through its guard.

name: Master Halo
description: Wear a master's halo that turns hard blows to a soft glow.

name: Mastered Tide
description: Lay a master's tide on a foe so every step costs it twice the strength.

name: Master Wake
description: Wake the sleeping talent of an ally with the practised touch of a master.

name: Master Phase
description: Shift one phase aside at the last instant and let a blow pass.

name: Master Eclipse
description: Draw a master's eclipse across a strong foe and blind and weigh it.

name: Vowed Surge
description: Send a sworn surge across a front that shoves each foe back to a set line.

name: Master Orbit
description: Set a powerful foe circling the user in a pull it cannot break.
